plain_english_revision: The amendment adds a definition to clarify that 'vessel' does not include any boat or ship built before 1918.
candidate_position_supported: This amendment restricts the scope of vessels subject to seizure and disposal procedures by explicitly excluding any vessel constructed prior to 1918 from the definition.
evidence_quotes: "On page 3, line 16, after 'water.' insert the following: This term does not include a vessel built or constructed before the year 1918."
